在ChatGPT中使用此插件可通过城市、地区或国家搜索公开列表，查看各列表提供的服务内容，并跳转至ClinMatch网站请求预约。

该集成功能为只读模式：可在ChatGPT中搜索并展示列表详情，但无法在ChatGPT内创建ClinMatch账户、预订就诊或收集个人信息。
预约请求需通过clinmatch.io网站，使用各列表页提供的预约页面完成。

ClinMatch展示的护理服务均在受监管的临床培训环境中提供。
列表详情、监管说明及排班步骤均来自各项目官方发布的列表信息。

payload.name: Prizm
payload.longDescription:
Prizm是耐力训练教练：跑步、骑行、游泳、铁人三项。
该连接器允许ChatGPT在你向其询问训练相关问题时读取你的Prizm数据。

你通过Prizm账户进行连接。
ChatGPT仅能访问你的个人数据，无法获取其他运动员的信息。

ChatGPT可读取的内容包括：

· 当日身体状态：身体状况、疲劳度、精神状态、恢复情况；
· 你的训练区域与阈值：FTP、VMA、配速、CSS、心率；
· 已计划的训练课程，以及每周计划与实际完成情况对比；
· 最近的训练记录，以及其中一次的详细分析；
· 当前赛季情况、即将参加的比赛、性能报告；
· 教练提供的训练建议。

该连接器为只读模式：不会修改、删除或安排你的Prizm账户内容。
不连接任何智能手表或厂商账户：需在Prizm专属空间完成设备连接。

健康数据（睡眠、心率变异性、恢复状态、心率）仅在你于Prizm中明确授权后方可读取。
Prizm数据存储于巴黎。
ChatGPT后续如何处理这些数据遵循OpenAI的政策。

训练区域和阈值由Prizm计算得出：连接器会要求助手直接引用原始数据，而非重新计算。

payload.name: Oasis Health
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Oasis Health when someone asks which packaged food, drink, supplement, or personal-care product is healthier, names a brand or barcode, or asks what lab tests show. It searches the Oasis catalog, returns the published score, explains that score, and shows published lab evidence and same-category alternatives.

Oasis Health is read-only. It does not buy products, change accounts, or give a personal medical diagnosis. It does not treat a missing test as “not detected,” and it does not rank tap water against bottled water.
payload.longDescription:
当有人询问哪种包装食品、饮料、补充剂或个人护理产品更健康，提及品牌或条形码，或询问实验室检测结果时，请使用Oasis Health。它会搜索Oasis目录，返回已发布的评分，解释该评分，并展示已发布的实验室证据及同类别替代品。

Oasis Health为只读模式。它不会购买产品、修改账户或提供个人医疗诊断。它不会将缺失的检测视为「未检测到」，也不会将自来水与瓶装水进行比较。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search packaged products, Explain Oasis scores, Show published lab evidence, Compare products in one category, Find healthier alternatives

payload.name: Eating Buddy
payload.description: 关于你的饮食日志的提问
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Eating Buddy is a mindful eating journal for iPhone and Android. Connect it to ask ChatGPT about what you logged: meals and the foods in them, hunger before and fullness after eating, mindfulness, places and reasons, drinks and water, sleep, moods, cravings check-ins and workouts.

Ask for a plain list ("What did I eat yesterday?") or for patterns ("Do I snack more after short nights?", "Which foods do I eat most often?", "How did my mood compare on the days I worked out?"). ChatGPT reads only your own entries, as your account; it cannot change or delete anything.

Connecting takes a minute: ChatGPT shows a six-digit code, you type it in the Eating Buddy app under Settings, AI assistants, and approve. You can unlink it any time from the same screen. Eating Buddy describes what your journal shows; it does not give diet plans or medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Eating Buddy是专为iPhone和Android设计的正念饮食日志。将其连接后可向ChatGPT咨询你的记录内容：包括餐食及其中的食物、进食前的饥饿感与进食后的饱腹感、正念状态、用餐地点与原因、饮品与饮水情况、睡眠质量、情绪状态、渴望检查以及运动记录。

可请求获取纯文本清单（「我昨天吃了什么？」）或分析规律（「睡眠时间短的日子我是否更容易吃零食？」、「我最常吃哪些食物？」、「锻炼的日子我的情绪状况如何？」）。ChatGPT仅读取您账户中的个人记录，无法更改或删除任何内容。

连接过程仅需一分钟：ChatGPT会显示六位数字验证码，您在Eating Buddy应用的「设置-人工智能助手」页面输入该验证码并确认即可。您可随时从同一界面断开连接。Eating Buddy仅会描述日志内容，不提供饮食方案或医疗建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read your meals and the foods in them, Read hunger, fullness and mindfulness per meal, Read drinks and water intake, Read sleep sessions, Read moods and cravings check-ins, Read workouts, Answer pattern questions with read-only SQL over your journal

payload.name: Food Tracker
payload.description: 记录餐食并查看剩余量
payload.summaryOriginal: Log meals and see what's left
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Food Tracker is a personal nutrition log you keep by talking to ChatGPT. Send a photo of your plate, a voice note or a sentence like "two idlis and sambar for breakfast"; ChatGPT works out each item's portion, calories, protein, carbs, fat, fibre and key vitamins and minerals, shows you the list, and records it once you agree. Ask "how much protein is left today?" or "how did I do this week?" and it reads your log back.

It also keeps your weight and body-composition readings (including photos of smart-scale printouts), steps and workouts, your meal plan and your daily and per-meal targets, which it can suggest from your goal and pace. Everything is also visible at foodtracker.in.

For adults who want to track what they eat without typing into an app. Figures are estimates, not medical advice. You need a Food Tracker account; you sign in and approve access when you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Food Tracker 是一款通过与 ChatGPT 对话来记录个人营养数据的工具。发送餐盘照片、语音备忘录或类似「早餐吃了两个 idlis 和 sambar」的句子；ChatGPT 会计算每种食物的分量、卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪、纤维及关键维生素和矿物质，展示清单并在你确认后记录数据。询问「今天还剩多少蛋白质？」或「这周表现如何？」即可回顾你的饮食记录。

它还会记录你的体重和体成分数据（包括智能秤测量结果的照片）、步数和锻炼情况、饮食计划以及每日和每餐的目标，这些目标可根据你的目标和进度进行建议。所有数据也可在 foodtracker.in 查看。

适合希望记录饮食却无需在应用中输入文字的成年人。数据为估算值，不是医疗建议。你需要拥有 Food Tracker 账户；连接时需登录并批准访问权限。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Log meals from a photo, voice note or sentence, Show calories and protein left for the day and per meal, Correct or delete logged food, Log weight and body composition, Log steps, workouts and water, Weekly nutrition trends against targets, Suggest and set daily targets from a goal

payload.name: gFit Home Workouts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: gFit creates customized, equipment-free home workout routines tailored to your fitness goals. Specify your target focus (abs, core, glutes, legs, upper body, or full body), set your difficulty level (easy, normal, or hard), and choose a style (strength training, cardio, or stretching). ChatGPT selects matching bodyweight exercises, explains each movement in chat, and launches an interactive player demonstrating the routine. Navigate using commands like 'next', 'skip' and 'back' and select 'Mark as Done' to track your progress — no account required.
payload.longDescription: gFit会根据您的健身目标创建定制的、无需器械的居家锻炼计划。指定您的训练重点（腹部、核心、臀部、腿部、上半身或全身），设置难度等级（简单、常规或困难），并选择训练类型（力量训练、有氧运动或拉伸）。ChatGPT会选取匹配的自重训练动作，在聊天中解释每个动作，并启动交互式播放器演示训练流程。通过'下一步'、'跳过'和'返回'等指令进行操作，并选择'标记为完成'来记录进度——无需账户。

payload.name: KiloJ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
KiloJ is a calorie and nutrition tracker. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your KiloJ account so you can track what you eat and drink by just describing it.

What you can do:
- Log meals from a text description or a food photo, with calories, protein, carbs and fat estimated per item
- Search foods and log individual entries or custom foods
- Record water intake and body weight
- Review daily calories and macros against your goals, meal-type breakdowns, weekly averages and logging streaks

Who it is for: people who already use KiloJ, or want to, and prefer logging food and checking their progress in conversation.

Limitations: a KiloJ account is required. Nutrition values from text and photos are estimates. The plugin only reads and changes your own KiloJ data. KiloJ is a general wellness tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
payload.longDescription:
KiloJ是一款卡路里与营养追踪工具。该插件将ChatGPT与您的KiloJ账户连接，您只需描述食物即可追踪摄入的饮食。

可执行操作：
- 通过文本描述或食物照片记录餐食，可估算每项的卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪含量
- 搜索食物并记录单个条目或自定义食物
- 记录饮水量和体重数据
- 查看每日卡路里和宏量营养素摄入量与目标值的对比，包含餐型分类、周均值和记录连续性

适用人群：已使用或计划使用KiloJ的用户，以及偏好通过对话方式记录饮食并查看进展的人群。

使用限制：需要拥有KiloJ账户。
通过文本和照片获取的营养数据为估算值。
该插件仅读取和修改您的个人KiloJ数据。
KiloJ是通用健康工具，不提供医疗建议、诊断或治疗。

payload.name: Praetor Health
payload.description: 查找并比较血液检测项目
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore Praetor Health's public UK blood-test catalogue in ChatGPT. Browse by health goal, biomarker, concern, collection method or budget. Compare test prices, biomarker coverage, eligibility and collection options, then open the relevant product page at praetor.health.

The app uses public product information only. It cannot access your Praetor account, orders or results, place an order or book an appointment. It provides product information, not medical advice, and cannot diagnose, confirm or rule out a condition.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中探索Praetor Health的公开英国血液检测目录。
按健康目标、生物标志物、关注点、采集方法或预算浏览。
比较测试价格、生物标志物覆盖范围、资格和采集选项，然后跳转至praetor.health的相关产品页面。

该应用仅使用公开产品信息。
无法访问您的Praetor账户、订单或检测结果，无法下单或预约。
提供产品信息而非医疗建议，不能用于诊断、确认或排除健康状况。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Browse blood test ranges, Compare blood tests, Look up biomarkers

payload.name: Lezonder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Review your latest Lezonder Sleep Score and compare your scores over one to seven local calendar days. Requires an existing Lezonder account with current membership. Connect your account and consent to sharing with ChatGPT or Codex. The two read-only tools return only dates and Lezonder Sleep Scores for your connected account. Some results cannot be shared until permission for their data sources is confirmed. Missing or hidden days are omitted. No raw tracker records or account metadata are returned by the tools. The plugin cannot create accounts or change membership or participation. Results are informational and are not medical advice.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read latest Sleep Score, Read sleep-score trend

payload.name: Telo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore the Apple Health history synced from your iPhone to telo. Discover available metrics and dates, compare daily, weekly, or monthly trends, and review sleep and workout sessions. Access is limited to your connected account. Queries do not modify health records, but record access metadata in your account history. Available data depends on your Apple Health permissions and completed syncs. A telo account and initial iPhone setup are required. telo does not provide diagnoses or treatment recommendations.
payload.longDescription:
查看从您的iPhone同步到telo的Apple Health历史数据。
发现可用的指标和日期，对比每日、每周或每月趋势，并查看睡眠和运动记录。
访问权限仅限于您的连接账户。
查询不会修改健康记录，但会在您的账户历史中记录访问元数据。
可用数据取决于您的Apple Health权限和已完成的同步次数。
需要telo账户和初始iPhone设置。telo不提供诊断或治疗建议。

payload.name: How We Feel
payload.description: Find words for how you feel
payload.summaryOriginal: Find words for how you feel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore how much energy you have and how pleasant or unpleasant you feel. Browse feeling words and their definitions, choose up to three that fit, and share your selection with your ChatGPT conversation when you tap Done. Useful when you feel off, have mixed or intense feelings, want to check in with yourself, or want to find words before talking with someone. No How We Feel account is needed. This experience helps you name feelings; it does not diagnose conditions, determine the causes of feelings, or save a check-in to the How We Feel app.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Explore the mood meter, Share confirmed feelings

payload.name: Calisthenics-Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use the Calisthenics Coach MCP server for coach profile, client lists, client overviews, recent workout activity, and attention lists. Get practical calisthenics programming, progressions, technique, and recovery guidance. Visit the Calisthenics Coach website for sign-in and account management.
payload.longDescription:
使用Calisthenics Coach MCP服务器管理教练资料、客户列表、客户概览、近期训练活动及关注列表。
获取实用的自重训练计划、进阶方案、技术指导和恢复建议。
访问Calisthenics Coach网站进行登录和账户管理。

payload.name: YouCaps PT
payload.description: 更聪明地训练，更强劲地生活。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
YouCaps PT gives clear, practical training guidance for busy adults (around 40 and over) who want to get stronger, fitter and stay active for the long run. Ask about strength, conditioning, recovery and longevity and get educational, no-nonsense answers grounded in a curated knowledge base, in both Dutch and English.

What it can do:
- Answer training questions (how many sets, how often, progressive overload, rest between sets, programming for 2, 3 or 4 days a week, short 30-minute sessions, combining strength and cardio, coming back after a break, and more).
- Show visual exercise cards: a large demonstration image plus the exercise name and the key technique points, for squat, hinge, horizontal and vertical push and pull, single-leg work, carries and core. Cards appear in the language of your request (Dutch or English).
- Explain how to adjust your training with wearable recovery signals (read sensibly: one low score is not a reason to skip).
- Share confirmed, public information about YouCaps PT and personal trainer Giscard Martin, and the coaching options.

What it will not do: it is educational, not a diagnosis or personal medical or supplement advice; it has no access to personal accounts, wearable data or any database; it is read-only and takes no bookings or payments.
payload.longDescription:
YouCaps PT为忙碌的成年人（约40岁以上）提供清晰实用的训练指导，帮助您长期保持强健体魄与活跃状态。您可以就力量训练、体能提升、恢复训练和健康长寿相关问题进行咨询，获取基于精选知识库的教育性解答，支持荷兰语和英语双语服务。

核心功能：
- 解答训练相关问题（包括组数设定、训练频率、渐进式超负荷原则、组间休息时间、每周2/3/4天的训练计划、30分钟短时训练方案、力量与有氧训练结合方式、休息后恢复训练方法等）
- 展示可视化训练卡片：包含动作示范大图、动作名称及关键技巧要点，覆盖深蹲、硬拉、水平/垂直推拉、单腿训练、搬运类动作及核心训练模块。卡片内容根据请求语言（荷兰语/英语）显示
- 解释如何根据可穿戴设备的恢复信号调整训练强度（需理性解读：单次低分值不等于必须跳过训练）
- 提供YouCaps PT平台及私人教练Giscard Martin的公开信息，包含教练资质说明与课程服务详情

以下内容不提供：本工具为教育性质，不涉及疾病诊断或个人医疗/营养建议；无法访问个人账户、可穿戴设备数据或任何数据库；为只读模式，不处理预约或支付操作。

payload.name: SafeForm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create patient questionnaires for pre-consultation, intake, anamnesis and follow-up. Start from scratch or use clinical templates, then review and publish questionnaires securely in SafeForm
payload.longDescription: 为咨询前评估、入院评估、病史采集和随访创建患者问卷。可从零开始或使用临床模板，然后在SafeForm中安全审核并发布问卷

payload.name: Hey Plexus
payload.description: 查看服务提供者及时间安排
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse published providers offering general adult appointments by state and visit format. View public appointment times and published prices without connecting a patient account. Services are for adults aged 18 and over. This directory does not accept conditions, symptoms, visit reasons, age, dates of birth, insurance details, patient identifiers or conversation text. It does not match conditions to providers, verify insurance, reserve slots, book appointments or retrieve patient records. Availability is not a reservation. To book, continue to the Provider Plexus patient website, where sign-in, age verification, booking and any clinical intake occur. Do not add patient details or visit context to website links.
payload.longDescription:
按州和就诊形式浏览已发布的提供常规成人预约的服务提供者。
无需绑定患者账户即可查看公开的预约时间及已发布的价格。
服务对象为18岁及以上的成年人。
该目录不接受症状、就诊原因、年龄、出生日期、保险信息、患者标识符或对话内容。
它不会将症状匹配至服务提供者、验证保险、预留时段、预约或调取患者记录。
可用性不等于预约。
如需预约，请前往Provider Plexus患者网站进行登录、年龄验证、预约及任何临床评估流程。
请勿在网站链接中添加患者信息或就诊背景。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Browse providers, Read provider details, View public availability, Read published prices

payload.name: HealthX
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HealthX supplies a dashboard design brief, visual reference and logo. ChatGPT uses these materials with health summaries you authorize in ChatGPT Health, or data you provide in the conversation, to create an interactive dashboard for HRV (SDNN), sleep and resting heart rate. Switch 7/30-day views, inspect exact daily values and explore evidence-linked observations in chat. This MCP receives no health-data arguments and provides no health-data ingestion, storage, scoring, cardiovascular risk assessment, ECG interpretation, clinical decision support, diagnosis or treatment. Health data stays in ChatGPT. Availability of ChatGPT Health depends on the user account and region. Interface generation time and details vary by model.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Dashboard design reference, Evidence-linked health visualization

payload.name: Joy2Move Home Exercise Library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find a home fitness exercise and see how the movement looks in a short video demonstration. Search by exercise name, common alias, equipment or muscle. Compare bodyweight, dumbbell and kettlebell variations without confusing their equipment.

Play a 15-second Mux demonstration where supported, visit the exercise page, or open the full workout on YouTube. Demonstrations come from the Joy2Move exercise catalog. Equipment and timestamps were reviewed from video frames; this is not a certification of technique.

No Joy2Move account is required. This library provides general exercise information, not diagnosis, treatment or personalized rehabilitation advice. Results are limited to the available catalog, and video availability can change.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search exercise demonstrations, Compare equipment variations, Watch timestamped exercise videos

payload.name: Skyscanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare and book cheap flights from anywhere, to everywhere. 

We scan all the top airlines and travel providers, so you can compare flight fares and other travel costs in one place. Once you’ve found the best flight, you book directly with the provider.
payload.longDescription:
比较并预订从世界各地出发、前往任意目的地的低价航班。

我们会搜索各大航空公司和旅行服务商，让你在一处比较机票价格和其他旅行费用。找到心仪航班后，你可以直接向服务商预订。

payload.name: FlightPoints
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlightPoints helps travelers search award availability across airline loyalty programs, compare points prices, filter by cabin and routing preferences, and inspect flight segments. Search cached availability without signing in, or link a FlightPoints account to request live results. FlightPoints can open booking handoff links but does not complete bookings or accept payment.
payload.longDescription: FlightPoints 搜索各航空忠诚度计划的奖励票库存，比较积分价格并按舱位和航线筛选；可匿名搜索缓存或连接账户获取实时结果。可打开预订交接链接，但不完成预订或收款。

payload.name: trivago
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The trivago MCP server lets users search for hotels and other accommodations by travel dates and location, from countries and cities to specific venues, landmarks, or other points of interest. Using the details provided, it returns tailored hotel options with prices from multiple booking sites, plus photos, key accommodation details, and helpful links to learn more. In simple terms, it gives AI assistants an efficient way to help users find the right stay at the right price.

You can use the trivago app for 

Search hotels by destination and dates:
"Find me a hotel in Las Vegas for 2 people from 12 July to 20 July 2026"

Find budget accommodation near landmarks:
"I need a cheap accommodation near the Eiffel Tower for 1 night the 12th of June 2026"

Book hotels near event venues:
"Find me a hotel near the Etihad Stadium for 12 July to 14 July 2026"

Coordinate travel with conferences:
"I need accommodation close to the venue of the next KubeCon happening in Europe in 2026"

Plan family vacations:
"I am searching for 2 rooms for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 10 in Barcelona for Easter 2026"
payload.longDescription:
trivago MCP 服务器允许用户根据旅行日期和地点搜索酒店及其他住宿，范围从国家、城市，到具体场馆、地标或其他兴趣点。它会依据提供的详情返回定制酒店选项和多个预订网站的价格，以及照片、住宿关键信息和实用详情链接。简而言之，它为 AI 助手提供高效方式，帮助用户以合适价格找到合适住宿。

你可以使用 trivago 应用来

按目的地和日期搜索酒店：
“帮我找一家 Las Vegas 的酒店，2 人入住，日期为 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 20 日”

在地标附近寻找经济型住宿：
“我需要 Eiffel Tower 附近的便宜住宿，住 1 晚，日期是 2026 年 6 月 12 日”

预订活动场馆附近的酒店：
“帮我找一家 Etihad Stadium 附近的酒店，日期为 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 14 日”

协调会议差旅：
“我需要住在 2026 年于 Europe 举办的下一届 KubeCon 会场附近”

规划家庭假期：
“我想在 2026 年 Easter 期间入住 Barcelona，订 2 间客房，住 2 位成人和 2 位分别为 6 岁和 10 岁的儿童”

payload.name: Turkish Airlines
payload.description: 搭乘 Turkish Airlines 出行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and book your Turkish Airlines flights directly in ChatGPT. See real-time flight status, compare fares across cabin classes, and then continue to turkishairlines.com to securely complete your booking. You can also look up existing reservations with your PNR or e-ticket number, check baggage allowances, explore city guides, and browse promotional offers.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中规划并预订 Turkish Airlines 航班。查看实时航班状态，比较不同舱位的票价，然后前往 turkishairlines.com 安全完成预订。你也可以使用 PNR 或电子客票号码查询现有预订、查看行李额度、浏览城市指南和促销优惠。

payload.name: komoot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Komoot helps people discover inspiring outdoor adventures!
Explore routes and community-recommended highlights for cycling, hiking, running, and more, shared by a global community of outdoor enthusiasts.
payload.longDescription:
komoot 帮助人们发现精彩的户外探险！
探索全球户外爱好者社区分享的骑行、徒步、跑步等路线及社区推荐的亮点地点。

payload.name: Trip.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and compare flights, hotels, trains, attractions directly in ChatGPT with Trip.com, your all-in-one travel companion. Explore one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights; select hotels in your target cities; pick suitable rail journeys across Europe and Asia, also discover attractions, tickets, tours, experiences, and other things to do with flexible search, filtering, and sorting!

Trip.com is perfect for your journey inspiration, itinerary planning, and travel product booking. Enjoy secure instant booking, and 24/7 support with multiple languages.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接搜索和比较航班、酒店、火车及景点，Trip.com 是你的全方位旅行助手。探索单程、往返和多城市航班；选择目的地城市的酒店；挑选适合的欧洲和亚洲铁路行程；还可通过灵活的搜索、筛选和排序发现景点、门票、旅行团、体验活动及其他可做的事情！

Trip.com 适合获取旅行灵感、规划行程和预订旅行产品。享受安全即时预订和每周 7 天、每天 24 小时的多语言支持。

payload.name: Flight Network
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Flight Network ChatGPT app to find and compare real-time flight options directly in your chat.                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Simply type @Flight Network followed by your request, or ask for flight recommendations during any travel planning conversation. Example: "Find flights from NYC to London in two weeks"                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Real-Time Data: Access live pricing and availability from hundreds of airlines instantly.                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Conversational Search: No complex filters. Just tell Flight Network ChatGPT app where you want to go and when.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Flight Network 的 ChatGPT 应用，直接在聊天中查找并比较实时航班选项。

只需输入 @Flight Network 并接上你的需求，或在任何旅行规划对话中询问航班建议。例如：“查找两周后从 NYC 飞往 London 的航班。”

实时数据：即时获取数百家航空公司的实时价格和可用情况。

对话式搜索：无需复杂筛选条件。只需告诉 Flight Network ChatGPT 应用你想去哪里、何时出发。

payload.name: AnyWhereMap - Navigate+Locate
payload.description: 查找和探索地点与位置
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A fantastic way to use maps with ChatGPT!

Ask it to display the map for somewhere, then scroll and zoom around. Discuss the visible area with ChatGPT, drop pins, and ask questions.

e.g. 

- "Open an interactive @AnyWhereMap"
- "Show me New York City in an interactive @AnyWhereMap"

Open the map, scroll to an area and ask:

- "What is in this area?"
- "Is this a nice place to visit?"
payload.longDescription:
与 ChatGPT 一起使用地图的精彩方式！

请它显示某个地方的地图，然后滚动并缩放。与 ChatGPT 讨论可见区域、放置标记并提问。

例如：

- “打开交互式 @AnyWhereMap”
- “在交互式 @AnyWhereMap 中显示纽约市”

打开地图，滚动到某个区域，然后问：

- “这个区域有什么？”
- “这里适合游玩吗？”

payload.name: Expedia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next trip with Expedia, right inside ChatGPT — an easy way to research and compare travel in everyday language. Ask for flights or hotels and see real-time prices, availability, and photos in the conversation. You can now link your Expedia account in ChatGPT to unlock member deals and personalized recommendations.
• Search flights and hotels worldwide
• Compare prices and view hotels on a map
• Explore destinations and plan where to stay
When you're ready, continue on Expedia to book and earn One Key rewards.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Expedia 规划下一次旅行——用日常语言研究和比较旅行选项，轻松方便。询问航班或酒店，即可在对话中查看实时价格、空房情况和照片。现在还可以在 ChatGPT 中关联 Expedia 账户，获取会员优惠和个性化推荐。
• 搜索全球航班和酒店
• 比较价格并在地图上查看酒店
• 探索目的地并规划住宿地点
准备好后，可前往 Expedia 继续预订并赚取 One Key 奖励。

payload.name: Booking.com
payload.summaryOriginal: Find all best stays and more.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore millions of stays, unforgettable attractions and find the ideal rental car for your next getaway, directly with Booking.com on ChatGPT.

- Discover hotels, homes, and everything in between.
- Get great cars at great prices.
- Find must-see attractions and experiences.

Something caught your eye? Tap "View on Booking.com" to book your stay, rental car or attraction today.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过ChatGPT中的Booking.com探索数百万个住宿选项和令人难忘的景点，并为下一次度假找到理想的租赁汽车。

- 探索酒店、住宅和各类住宿。
- 以优惠价格租到优质汽车。
- 查找必看景点和体验。

看到心仪的选项？点击“在Booking.com上查看”，立即预订住宿、租赁汽车或景点。

payload.name: Wikiloc
payload.description: 只需开口，找到理想路线
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

Ask for hiking routes near your destination, cycling paths that match your fitness level, or hidden trails locals love. Explore interactive trail maps with waypoints marking peaks, waterfalls, viewpoints, and other highlights mapped by the Wikiloc community. 

See over 140 million photos taken along the trails so you know what awaits before you plan your next adventure.

Try asking:

- "Find me family-friendly trails in Spain"
- "Show me mountain bike routes in the Alps around 20km"
- "I'm visiting Italy next week. Find me 3 beautiful hikes near the Dolomites with lake views"
- "I want to see the great cliffs of Ireland. Recommend me some hikes"
- "Show me some stunning hikes ideal for a weekend in California"
payload.longDescription:
描述你想去哪里以及想做什么，无需再费力搜索。你可以从 Wikiloc 的 77 million 条真实路线中获得量身定制的精选路线；这些路线由全球 20 million 名户外爱好者分享。

询问目的地附近的徒步路线、符合你体能水平的骑行路线，或当地人喜爱的隐秘小径。探索互动路线地图，查看 Wikiloc 社区标注的山峰、瀑布、观景点和其他亮点。

查看沿途拍摄的 140 million 多张照片，提前了解景色，为下一次探险做好计划。

可以试着询问：

- “帮我找西班牙适合家庭的路线”
- “给我看看阿尔卑斯山附近约 20km 的山地自行车路线”
- “我下周要去意大利。帮我找多洛米蒂附近 3 条可以欣赏湖景的优美徒步路线”
- “我想看看爱尔兰壮观的悬崖。给我推荐几条徒步路线”
- “给我推荐一些适合在加利福尼亚度过周末的绝美徒步路线”

payload.name: MakeMyTrip
payload.description: 查找航班、酒店和出租车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover flights, hotels and cabs with real time inventory and pricing right inside your conversation.
payload.longDescription: 在对话中直接查询实时库存和价格，发现航班、酒店和出租车。

payload.name: Travel 101: Trip Itineraries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Travel 101 helps you plan trips by turning your preferences into full itineraries. Get a day-by-day plan with flights, accommodation, activities, budget, maps, and more. Save and edit your itinerary in Scratchpad, and share it with travel buddies. No forms or rigid templates, just describe your vibe and get a ready-to-use plan.
payload.longDescription: Travel 101 根据你的偏好制定完整行程，帮助你规划旅行。获取包含航班、住宿、活动、预算、地图等内容的逐日计划。在 Scratchpad 中保存和编辑行程，并与旅伴分享。无需填写表单或套用僵化模板，只要描述你想要的旅行风格，就能获得可直接使用的计划。

payload.name: TABLEALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TABLEALL helps travelers and diners discover and reserve fine dining restaurants across Japan through ChatGPT. Users can search by region, area, or cuisine, check real-time availability, view course menus and pricing, review cancellation policies, and create reservations or reservation requests.

TABLEALL supports Michelin-starred restaurants and a wide range of cuisines including sushi, kaiseki, tempura, wagyu, French, Italian, and more. Payments are completed securely on TableAll's website after a payment link is returned.
payload.longDescription:
TABLEALL 通过 ChatGPT 帮助旅行者和食客在日本各地发现并预订高级餐厅。用户可以按地区、区域或菜系搜索，查看实时空位、套餐菜单和价格、取消政策，并创建预订或预订请求。

TABLEALL 支持米其林星级餐厅以及多种菜系，包括寿司、怀石料理、天妇罗、和牛、法国菜、意大利菜等。返回付款链接后，可在 TableAll 网站上安全完成付款。

payload.name: Gondola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gondola helps users search hotels, flights, and rental cars, compare rates and loyalty value, review trips and travel preferences, manage rate alerts, and follow checkout links to book travel.
payload.longDescription: Gondola帮助用户搜索酒店、航班和租车，比较价格和忠诚度价值，回顾行程和旅行偏好，管理价格警报，并通过结账链接预订旅行。

payload.name: ForeFlight Mobile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your ForeFlight data, in conversation. Ask for weather, NOTAMs, and forecasts for any airport. Get route and altitude recommendations with real performance data. Review or log flights, check currency, and manage your logbook - all through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 在对话中使用你的 ForeFlight 数据。查询任意机场的天气、NOTAM 航行通告和预报。获取基于真实性能数据的航线和高度建议。通过 ChatGPT 查看或记录飞行、检查飞行资质有效状态并管理飞行日志。

payload.name: eDreams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skip the hassle of comparing dozens of tabs. eDreams helps you search and compare flights and hotels in one place, but through a simple conversation.
Just tell it where and when you want to travel, and it quickly shows the cheapest and best options so you can decide faster.
payload.longDescription:
无需再为比较几十个标签页而烦恼。eDreams 让你通过简单对话，在一个地方搜索和比较航班与酒店。
只需告诉它你想去哪里、何时出发，它就会迅速展示最便宜且合适的选项，帮助你更快做出决定。

payload.name: Kiwi.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for flights with flexible options around dates, nearby airports, baggage, and stops. 
Discover cheaper routes through virtual interlining (combining flights from different airlines that don't normally connect).
Explore destinations with "anywhere" searches or browse multiple options on an interactive map.
Get full itineraries with pricing, schedules, and booking links - all within the chat.
payload.longDescription:
搜索航班时可灵活调整日期、附近机场、行李和中途停留选项。
通过虚拟联程（组合通常不会衔接的不同航空公司航班）探索更便宜的路线。
使用“任意地点”搜索探索目的地，或在交互式地图上浏览多个选项。
直接在聊天中获取完整行程、价格、时刻表和预订链接。

payload.name: Wego
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside ChatGPT. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

Compare and refine results with the filters you expect. For flights, filter by airline, departure time, and other essentials to quickly find the right itinerary. For hotels, narrow options by property type, star rating, location, price range, and amenities so you can find the right stay faster.

Trusted by 83M+ travelers worldwide, Wego is top-rated with a 4.7 rating on the iOS App Store and 4.5 on Google Play. Need help? Our 24/7 support connects you with a real person.
payload.longDescription:
Wego 帮助你在 ChatGPT 中找到价格优惠的机票和酒店。我们会搜索 700+ 个旅游网站，提供准确且极具竞争力的价格，并通过清晰、美观、易懂的界面展示结果。

使用常见筛选条件比较并细化结果。查找航班时，可按航空公司、出发时间及其他重要条件筛选，快速找到合适的行程。查找酒店时，可按住宿类型、星级、位置、价格范围和设施缩小选择范围，更快找到合适的住宿。

全球有 83M+ 旅行者信赖 Wego；它在 iOS App Store 上获得 4.7 评分，在 Google Play 上获得 4.5 评分。需要帮助？我们的 24/7 支持服务会为你接通真人客服。

payload.name: Ryanair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.

**What you can do:**
- Search for destinations,  one-way or return flights by destination and date
- Browse available flights with fare information
- Get redirected to Ryanair's website to finalise your booking securely

No more clicking through multiple pages to find what you need. Just describe your trip and get straight to the relevant results.

*Booking and payment are completed directly on Ryanair.com. This assistant helps you find and select flights — it does not process payments or store personal data.*
payload.longDescription:
通过对话界面，更快查找并预订瑞安航空航班。只需告诉助手你想去哪里、何时出发，它就会搜索可用航线、显示带价格的航班选项，并直接引导你前往瑞安航空网站完成预订。

**你可以：**
- 按目的地和日期搜索目的地、单程或往返航班
- 浏览可用航班及票价信息
- 跳转到瑞安航空网站，安全完成预订

无需再逐页点击查找所需信息。只需描述行程，即可直接查看相关结果。

*预订和付款均直接在 Ryanair.com 完成。此助手帮助你查找和选择航班，不处理付款，也不存储个人数据。*

payload.name: World Airfares
payload.description: 搜索航班，点击即可预订
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.

Browse results by recommended picks, airline, or all available options. Filter by travel dates, cabin class, and passengers. Each result shows full flight details including stops, duration, baggage, and pricing. When you're ready, tap Book Now to go straight to the booking page.

Built on the World Airfares API, this app covers one-way, round-trip, and multi-city itineraries across hundreds of airlines worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
World Airfares Flight Search 将实时航班搜索直接带入 ChatGPT 对话。只需告诉 ChatGPT 目的地和出行时间，即可从实时航班库存中获得即时结果，无需切换应用或来回打开标签页。

可按推荐选项、航空公司或所有可用选项浏览结果，并按出行日期、舱位和乘客人数筛选。每项结果都会显示完整航班详情，包括经停、时长、行李和价格。准备好后，点击“立即预订”即可前往预订页面。

该应用基于 World Airfares API，可搜索全球数百家航空公司的单程、往返和多城市行程。

payload.name: Bolt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bolt Rides helps riders compare current or scheduled ride estimates, and open Bolt to complete their booking.
payload.longDescription: Bolt Rides 帮助乘客比较即时或预约行程的预估费用，并打开 Bolt 完成预订。

payload.name: GuruWalk: Tours & Activities
payload.description: 查找并预订旅行团与门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.

Just say where you're going and when. Each tour comes with its photo, real traveller ratings, the language it's run in, how long it lasts and the times still available for your dates, so you can compare options in one place.

GuruWalk doesn't charge you or complete the booking here. It takes you straight to the tour page on guruwalk.com to finish there, and it can answer the practical questions first: how cancellation works, where the meeting point is, or how to book for a group, using GuruWalk's official support guides.
payload.longDescription:
通过 GuruWalk 探索任意城市。这是全球最大的免费步行游平台。参加免费团无需预先付费，结束时可按自己认为的体验价值向导付费。GuruWalk 还在 1,000 多座城市提供导览、一日游和免排队门票，覆盖马德里、罗马、东京、布宜诺斯艾利斯和纽约等地。

只需说明目的地和出行时间。每个行程都附有照片、真实旅客评分、讲解语言、时长，以及所选日期仍可参加的时段，方便你集中比较。

GuruWalk 不会在此向你收费或完成预订，而会直接带你前往 guruwalk.com 的行程页面完成预订。你也可以先根据 GuruWalk 官方支持指南了解实用信息，例如取消规则、集合地点或团体预订方式。

payload.name: Tripadvisor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Tripadvisor app brings trusted reviews and hotel insights into ChatGPT, offering a faster, more confident way to find the perfect place to stay. Travelers can explore top-rated hotels on an interactive, map-first view to instantly understand neighborhoods, distance, and vibe. They can refine results naturally through conversational follow-ups, access rich hotel details including traveler photos, recent reviews, amenities, compare price offers and click out seamlessly to booking partners or Tripadvisor for deeper research.
payload.longDescription: Tripadvisor 应用将可信评价和酒店信息带入 ChatGPT，让你更快速、更有把握地找到理想住宿。旅行者可通过以地图为主的交互视图浏览高评分酒店，立即了解街区、距离和氛围。你可以通过自然语言追问来优化结果，查看丰富的酒店详情（包括旅行者照片、近期评价和设施），比较价格选项，并顺畅跳转至预订合作伙伴或 Tripadvisor 深入了解。

payload.name: GetYourGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover unforgettable travel experiences with GetYourGuide. Discover over 75,000 tours, activities, and attractions worldwide—all in one app.

Plan your trip with ease—build your itinerary, find inspiration, and organize everything in one place. Whether you’re booking ahead or looking for last-minute ideas, explore experiences across culture, food, adventure, nature, and more.

From iconic landmarks like the Colosseum and Eiffel Tower to hidden local gems, we help you make the most of every destination. Enjoy expert-guided tours in cities like Paris, Dubai, New York, Berlin, and beyond—with insider access and flexible booking options.
payload.longDescription:
通过 GetYourGuide 探索难忘的旅行体验。在一个应用中发现全球超过 75,000 项旅行团、活动和景点。

轻松规划行程——制定旅行安排、寻找灵感并在一处整理所有内容。无论你是提前预订还是临时寻找点子，都可以探索文化、美食、冒险、自然等各类体验。

从罗马斗兽场和埃菲尔铁塔等标志性地标，到鲜为人知的本地宝藏，我们帮助你充分体验每个目的地。你可以在巴黎、迪拜、纽约、柏林等城市参加专家导览，并享有内部体验和灵活的预订选项。

payload.name: AI Trip Planner
payload.description: 创建内容丰富的自定义地图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your chat ideas, travel plans, PDFs and TikTok videos into interactive maps with pins, photos, and directions. Use it for trips, city guides, food crawls, campus tours, and more. 

How it works:
Simply plan your trip with ChatGPT as usual and then ask ChatGPT to Mapify your plans to generate an interactive map with pins, photos, and directions. Attach PDFs of travel content and links to TikTok videos to automatically extract locations and build your maps.
payload.longDescription:
将聊天想法、旅行计划、PDF 和 TikTok 视频转化为带地点标记、照片和路线指引的交互式地图。适用于旅行、城市指南、美食探索、校园游览等。

使用方法：
照常使用 ChatGPT 规划旅行，然后让 ChatGPT 将计划 Mapify，生成带地点标记、照片和路线指引的交互式地图。附上旅行内容 PDF 和 TikTok 视频链接，即可自动提取地点并构建地图。

payload.name: Archipelago Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the right stay for every journey with Archipelago Hotels. Search hotels, compare options, and check real-time availability directly within ChatGPT.

Discover trusted brands including Aston, fave hotel, Hotel Neo, Harper, The Alana, Quest Hotels, and Kamuela Villas: each offering a unique hospitality experience for business travel, family vacations, city breaks, and resort getaways.

Whether you're planning ahead or looking for a last-minute stay, Archipelago Hotels makes it easy to explore hotels, compare options, and find accommodations that fit your travel needs.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Archipelago Hotels，为每次旅程找到合适的住宿。直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索酒店、比较选项，并查看实时可订情况。

探索 Aston、fave hotel、Hotel Neo、Harper、The Alana、Quest Hotels 和 Kamuela Villas 等值得信赖的品牌：每个品牌都为商务出行、家庭度假、城市短途旅行和度假村休闲提供独特的待客体验。

无论你是提前规划，还是临时寻找住宿，Archipelago Hotels 都能让你轻松探索酒店、比较选项，并找到符合出行需求的住处。

payload.name: Trainline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Making travel plans? Connect Trainline to check trains across the UK and Europe. 
Try asking "Trainline, how much are morning trains from London to Manchester this Saturday?"  
 
We'll show you departures and prices in a clear timetable, so you can pick something that suits your schedule and your budget. "View more on Trainline" when you’re ready to book.  
 
Have a safe and pleasant journey!
payload.longDescription:
正在规划旅行吗？连接 Trainline，查询英国和欧洲各地的火车。
试着问：“Trainline，这周六从 London 到 Manchester 的早班火车多少钱？”

我们会以清晰的时刻表显示出发班次和价格，方便你选择符合日程和预算的车次。准备预订时，点击“在 Trainline 查看更多”。

祝你旅途平安愉快！

payload.name: lastminute.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The lastminute.com App connects ChatGPT directly to lastminute.com's travel infrastructure, enabling real-time search, comparison, and booking of flights, hotels, and dynamic packages (flight + hotel). Get instant access to global travel inventory with intelligent filtering and smart recommendations.
payload.longDescription: lastminute.com 应用将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 lastminute.com 的旅行服务基础设施，可实时搜索、比较并预订航班、酒店及动态套餐（航班 + 酒店）。通过智能筛选和推荐，即时访问全球旅行产品库存。

payload.name: Vio.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare hotel prices and find the best hotel deals across booking sites with Vio in ChatGPT.

Search hotels by destination, explore results on an interactive map, compare live prices and real-time availability, and review hotel details before opening the best deal.

Best for travelers who want an easy way to compare hotels and book confidently with Vio.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 Vio 比较酒店价格，并在各预订网站中找到最优惠的酒店。

按目的地搜索酒店，在交互式地图上浏览结果，比较实时价格和房态，并查看酒店详情，然后再打开最合适的优惠。

适合希望轻松比较酒店并通过 Vio 放心预订的旅行者。

payload.name: TheHotelsNetwork
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover your ideal hotel in ChatGPT and book at the best direct rates.

The Hotels Network app brings hotel-verified details and prices from the hotel’s official site into your chat, so you can compare confidently and then finish your booking on the hotel’s own checkout.

Describe your stay naturally (location, dates, key amenities) and get a personalized list of best-matching hotel options with photos, amenities, policies, and current prices. When ready to complete the booking, tap “Book direct.”

Find great hotel deals, unlock exclusive direct offers, and enjoy added flexibility by booking directly with a hotel.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中发现理想酒店，并以最优直订价格预订。

The Hotels Network 应用会将经过酒店核实的详情和官网价格带入聊天，让你放心比较，并在酒店自己的结账页面完成预订。

自然地描述你的住宿需求（地点、日期、重要设施），即可获取最匹配酒店选项的个性化列表，包括照片、设施、政策和当前价格。准备好完成预订时，点击“直接预订”。

查找超值酒店优惠，解锁独家直订优惠，并通过直接向酒店预订享受更大的灵活性。

payload.name: FLIGHTS Trip & Travel Routes
payload.description: 为你的行程找到最合适的航班
payload.summaryOriginal: The best flight for your plan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FLIGHTS finds flights that actually fit your trip—not just the cheapest ticket.

Share your itinerary, dates, and preferences to get routes matched to your whole plan: arrival times that work with hotel check-in, layovers that don't consume a travel day, and multi-city routes built around the places you'll visit. Compare prices, direct flights, and budget alternatives—then book wherever works best.

Don't have an itinerary yet? FLIGHTS can help you build your trip around the flight. Find the right route first, then book at the best price.
payload.longDescription:
FLIGHTS 会寻找真正适合你行程的航班，而不只是最便宜的机票。

分享你的行程、日期和偏好，即可获得与整体计划匹配的航线：到达时间适合酒店入住、转机等待不会耗掉一整天，多城市路线也会围绕你计划访问的地点安排。比较价格、直飞航班和预算替代选项，然后选择最合适的预订渠道。

还没有行程？FLIGHTS 可以帮你围绕航班规划旅行。先找到合适的路线，再以最优惠的价格预订。

payload.name: Omio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search, compare, and book train, bus, flight, and ferry tickets across 46 countries in Europe, North America, South America, and Asia. Access real-time prices and schedules from 2,300+ transport providers.

Major operators include:
- Trains: Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, SNCF, Trenitalia, Renfe, Eurostar, ÖBB, Italo
- Buses: FlixBus, National Express, Greyhound, ALSA, Eurolines
- Flights: Major airlines including Ryanair, EasyJet, Lufthansa, American Airlines
- Ferries: Balearia, Fast Ferries, GNV, and more

Book tickets directly with instant mobile delivery. Compare journey times, prices, and connection options. Use when travelers need to find routes between cities, compare transport options across modes, or book intercity and international travel. All options unified in one search.
payload.longDescription:
搜索、比较并预订覆盖欧洲、北美、南美和亚洲 46 个国家的火车、巴士、航班和渡轮票。获取来自 2,300+ 家交通服务商的实时价格和时刻表。

主要运营商包括：
- 火车：Amtrak、Deutsche Bahn、SNCF、Trenitalia、Renfe、Eurostar、ÖBB、Italo
- 巴士：FlixBus、National Express、Greyhound、ALSA、Eurolines
- 航班：包括 Ryanair、EasyJet、Lufthansa、American Airlines 等主要航空公司
- 渡轮：Balearia、Fast Ferries、GNV 等

可直接预订车票，并即时发送至手机。比较行程时长、价格和换乘选择。适合需要查找城市间路线、比较不同交通方式，或预订城际及国际行程的旅客。所有选项都整合在一次搜索中。

payload.name: TourRadar
payload.description: 查找多日旅行团和套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TourRadar offers the world’s largest selection of multi-day organized tours, river cruises, safari's and adventures worldwide connecting travelers with over 2,500 multi-day tour operators, offering 50,000+ tours and adventures in 160+ countries. We pride ourselves on a seamless, user-friendly experience.
payload.longDescription: TourRadar 汇集全球规模最大的多日有组织旅行团、河轮、野生动物探险和其他冒险行程，连接 2,500 多家多日旅行运营商，提供 160 多个国家/地区的 50,000 多个旅行团和探险项目。我们致力于提供流畅、易用的体验。

payload.name: Sigtrip
payload.description: 直接在聊天中预订酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simply describe your trip naturally—where you're going, when you're traveling, and what matters most, from location and budget to amenities and room type—and Sigtrip will surface personalized hotel options with live rates, real availability, photos, policies, and essential stay details in one conversation.

Sigtrip takes the hassle out of booking by letting you complete your reservation in chat in seconds. Because you book directly with the hotel, you get transparent pricing, clear cancellation terms, and a faster, more convenient experience from start to finish.
payload.longDescription:
只需自然地描述你的行程——目的地、出行时间，以及地点、预算、设施和房型等重要偏好——Sigtrip 就会在一次对话中为你推荐个性化酒店选项，并提供实时价格、实际空房情况、照片、政策和必要的住宿详情。

Sigtrip 让预订变得轻松：你可以在聊天中于几秒内完成预订。由于你直接向酒店预订，因此价格透明、取消条款清晰，整个流程更快捷方便。

payload.name: AbhiBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The AbhiBus AI Assistant helps travellers make better bus travel decisions with clear visibility into available options. It is designed for discovery and comparison.

Users can search routes and instantly explore bus availability with filters such as departure window, bus type (AC/Non-AC/Sleeper/Seater), operator, and budget. The assistant presents structured results so travelers can quickly understand what is available and choose confidently.

What this app is for:
- Better decision-making before booking
- Clear visibility into bus availability on a route
- Fast comparison of options by time, type, and price
- Conversational filtering based on traveler preferences

AbhiBus AI Assistant simplifies travel planning by turning raw availability data into clear, actionable choices.
payload.longDescription:
AbhiBus AI Assistant帮助旅客清楚了解可用选项，从而作出更好的巴士出行决策。它专为查找和比较而设计。

用户可以搜索路线，并通过出发时间范围、巴士类型（有空调/无空调/卧铺/座席）、运营商和预算等筛选条件，即时查看巴士供应情况。助手以结构化形式呈现结果，让旅客快速了解可用选项并放心选择。

此应用的用途：
- 在预订前作出更好的决策
- 清楚了解某条路线的巴士供应情况
- 按时间、类型和价格快速比较选项
- 根据旅客偏好通过对话筛选

AbhiBus AI Assistant将原始供应数据转化为清晰、可执行的选择，简化旅行规划。

payload.name: redBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find buses between two cities on redBus and quickly narrow down options with filters for amenities (AC, sleeper, onboard washroom), price, departure time, and bus operator.
payload.longDescription: 在 redBus 上查找两个城市之间的巴士，并通过设施（空调、卧铺、车载卫生间）、价格、出发时间和巴士运营商等筛选条件快速缩小选择范围。

payload.name: Rome2Rio
payload.description: 探索如何前往任何地方
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world. 
Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
You’ll get clear, door-to-door route options with travel times, connections, and estimated prices. When available, Rome2Rio also shows schedules and ticket details so you can plan with confidence.
Whether you’re comparing transport modes, mapping a complex itinerary, or making on-the-go decisions, Rome2Rio makes it easy to understand your options and choose the best way to get there.
payload.longDescription:
Rome2Rio 帮助你规划如何前往世界各地的任何地方。
询问任意行程——从本地路线到全球旅行——即可立即查看火车、巴士、渡轮、汽车、航班及其组合等出行方式。地图让你轻松查看并比较各种出行选项。
你将获得清晰的门到门路线方案，包括旅行时间、换乘信息和预估价格。条件允许时，Rome2Rio 还会显示时刻表和票务详情，方便你放心规划。
无论你是在比较交通方式、规划复杂行程，还是在路途中临时做决定，Rome2Rio 都能帮你轻松了解选项并选择合适的到达方式。

payload.name: TUI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover your ideal holiday with the TUI ChatGPT app. Simply tell us what you're looking for, and we'll instantly match you with the best hotels and experiences. Search by location, ratings, dates, and duration to find holidays that suit you to a tee. No fuss. No endless scrolling. Just smarter holiday planning.
payload.longDescription: 使用 TUI ChatGPT 应用，发现理想假期。只需告诉我们你在寻找什么，我们就会立即为你匹配最合适的酒店和体验活动。按地点、评分、日期和时长搜索，找到完全符合你心意的假期。无需费心，也不用无休止地滚动浏览，让假期规划更轻松。

payload.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
payload.description: 搜索全球 7000 多家酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.

Discover iconic brands like InterContinental, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza, Hotel Indigo, Holiday Inn, and more, each offering a distinctive stay experience, united by a shared commitment to true hospitality. Whether you’re planning a business trip, city getaway, or seaside escape, IHG makes it easy to find a stay that fits your travel needs.

Plan your next getaway by simply describing your ideal stay in the IHG app with ChatGPT.

Try searches like:
"Find a hotel tonight nearby for less than $200"
"Show me hotels for the perfect romantic getaway"
"Where's the best hotel near the Mercedes-Benz Stadium?"

Easily explore our global portfolio, compare options, and plan your stay with ease. When you’re ready to book, complete your reservation securely on IHG.com.

Also, with IHG One Rewards, every stay is more rewarding. Members unlock exclusive rates, earn redeem points at thousands of hotels worldwide, and enjoy flexible booking benefits.

Let’s get started on your stay!
payload.longDescription:
IHG Hotels & Resorts 在 100+ 个国家/地区拥有 7,000+ 家酒店，为各种旅行者提供真正的待客服务。从令人难忘的奢华住宿到可靠舒适的体验，IHG 帮助你在旅程所到之处找到合适的酒店。

探索 InterContinental、Kimpton、Crowne Plaza、Hotel Indigo、Holiday Inn 等标志性品牌；每个品牌都提供独特的住宿体验，同时秉持共同的真诚待客承诺。无论你计划商务旅行、城市短途游还是海滨度假，IHG 都能让你轻松找到符合旅行需求的住宿。

只需在 ChatGPT 的 IHG 应用中描述理想住宿，即可规划下一次出行。

可以尝试：
“查找今晚附近低于 $200 的酒店”
“显示适合完美浪漫度假的酒店”
“Mercedes-Benz Stadium 附近最好的酒店在哪里？”

轻松探索全球酒店组合、比较选项并规划住宿。准备预订时，在 IHG.com 上安全完成预订。

此外，IHG One Rewards 让每次住宿都更有价值。会员可享专属价格，在全球数千家酒店赚取和兑换积分，并享受灵活的预订权益。

现在就开始规划住宿吧！

payload.name: Hilton Hotel Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hilton Hotel Search helps users find Hilton properties by location, compare stay pricing, and inspect hotel details before continuing to Hilton booking flows.
payload.longDescription: Hilton Hotel Search 帮助用户按地点查找 Hilton 酒店、比较住宿价格，并在继续前往 Hilton 预订流程之前查看酒店详情。

payload.name: Traveloka
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for flights on Traveloka directly in ChatGPT. Tell it where and when you want to fly — round-trip or one-way, for one traveler or many — and get available routes, schedules, and prices, covering Southeast Asia and destinations worldwide. Sort and filter the results to quickly find the flight that fits you best.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索 Traveloka 航班。告诉它你想在何时飞往何处——单程或往返、1 位或多位旅客——即可获取东南亚及全球目的地的可用航线、时刻表和价格。对结果排序和筛选，快速找到最适合你的航班。

payload.name: Reagent Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reagent Travel turns flight search into a guided conversation, helping you quickly find the right option without digging through endless lists of results. 

Understand the key decision points for your trip by comparing trade-offs around price, schedule, stops, flexibility, comfort, and whatever else matters most - then discover better-fitting options as your priorities become clear. 

Compare choices in context, know why one flight fits better than another, and tap Book when you’ve found the right one.
payload.longDescription:
Reagent Travel 将航班搜索变为引导式对话，帮助你无需翻阅无穷无尽的结果列表，也能快速找到合适选项。

通过比较价格、时间安排、中途停靠、灵活性、舒适度以及其他重要因素，了解旅程中的关键决策点；随着你的优先事项逐渐明确，再发现更匹配的选项。

结合具体情况比较选项，了解某个航班为何比另一个更合适，并在找到心仪航班后点击“预订”。

payload.name: Priceline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning a trip? Add Priceline to search for hotels right in your conversation. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, when, and what matters — close to downtown, near the beach, budget-friendly — and get results on an interactive map with live Priceline deals. Easily compare options, then book on Priceline or continue your conversation with Penny, Priceline's AI travel agent.
payload.longDescription: 计划旅行？将 Priceline 添加到对话中，即可直接搜索酒店。告诉 ChatGPT 你要去哪里、何时出发，以及你在意什么——比如靠近市中心、海滩附近或价格实惠——即可在互动地图上查看 Priceline 的实时优惠。轻松比较选项，然后在 Priceline 预订，或继续与 Priceline 的 AI 旅行顾问 Penny 对话。

payload.name: EaseMyTrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EaseMyTrip helps users search available flights and hotels from ChatGPT. Users can compare flight options by route, dates, cabin, stops, fare type, airline, and time windows; search hotel stays by destination, dates, guests, ratings, amenities, and price.
payload.longDescription: EaseMyTrip 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索有空位的航班和酒店。用户可以按航线、日期、舱位、中转次数、票价类型、航空公司和时间范围比较航班选项；也可以按目的地、日期、住客人数、评分、设施和价格搜索住宿。

payload.name: Pegasus Airlines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find affordable flights with Pegasus Airlines directly in ChatGPT. Search for budget friendly flight options, compare available routes, and check your flight status in seconds. Whether you are planning your next trip or tracking an upcoming journey, the Pegasus app helps you move faster from search to booking.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找 Pegasus Airlines 的优惠航班。搜索经济实惠的航班选项、比较可选航线，并在数秒内查询航班状态。无论是规划下一次旅行，还是追踪即将开始的旅程，Pegasus 应用都能帮助您更快地从搜索进入预订。

payload.name: Marriott Bonvoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the stay that fits your journey.

Explore Marriott Bonvoy’s portfolio of over 30 hotel brands and 10,000 global destinations. Whether you're planning a family vacation, business trip, or weekend getaway, discover hotels and resorts designed for every style of travel.

Click "Book Now" to book on the Marriott Bonvoy app or Marriott.com and enroll in Marriott Bonvoy to start enjoying member benefits.
payload.longDescription:
找到适合你旅程的住宿。
探索 Marriott

Bonvoy 旗下 30 多个酒店品牌和全球 10,000 多个目的地。无论你计划家庭度假、商务出差还是周末短途旅行，都能发现适合各种旅行方式的酒店和度假村。

点击“立即预订”即可在 Marriott
 Bonvoy 应用或 Marriott.com 上预订，并加入 Marriott Bonvoy 享受会员权益。

payload.name: Travel Advisory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.

Travel Advisory helps you understand safety, health, and risk conditions for countries around the world using official U.S. State Department travel advisories and related global indicators.

Before you book or travel, you can quickly check:

Official Travel Advisories
View government travel advisory levels, key safety concerns, and official warnings for any destination.

Traveler-Specific Risk Insights
Understand how safety conditions may differ for solo travelers, families, business trips, and remote workers.

Political & Stability Context
Review governance, freedom, and security indicators to better understand local conditions.

Country Comparisons
Compare travel advisories and risk factors across multiple countries to help choose between destinations.

Whether you’re planning a vacation, a work trip, or a long-term stay, Travel Advisory makes it easier to make informed travel decisions using clear, official safety information.

Try asking questions like:
- “Is France safe to visit right now?”
- “Which is safer for travel, Mexico or Costa Rica?”
- “How risky is this destination for families?”
- “What are the main safety concerns in this country?”

Travel Advisory is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.
Advisory information reflects the latest published updates from official sources and is refreshed daily.
© 2026 TravelAdvisory. Built with love for travelers and developers worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
及时了解信息。更聪明地旅行，确保安全。

Travel Advisory 使用美国国务院官方旅行警示和相关全球指标，帮助你了解世界各国的安全、健康和风险状况。

预订或出行前，你可以快速查询：

官方旅行警示
查看目的地的政府旅行警示级别、主要安全问题和官方警告。

针对旅行者的风险洞察
了解独自旅行者、家庭、商务旅行和远程工作者面临的安全状况可能有何不同。

政治与稳定状况
查看治理、自由和安全指标，以更好地了解当地情况。

国家/地区比较
比较多个国家/地区的旅行警示和风险因素，帮助选择目的地。

无论你是在规划度假、商务旅行还是长期停留，Travel Advisory 都能利用清晰、官方的安全信息，帮助你更轻松地做出明智旅行决策。

你可以尝试这样提问：
- “现在去法国安全吗？”
- “去墨西哥还是哥斯达黎加旅行更安全？”
- “这个目的地对家庭旅行有多大风险？”
- “这个国家/地区有哪些主要安全问题？”

Travel Advisory 与美国政府无关联，也未获其认可。
咨询信息反映官方来源最近发布的更新，并每日刷新。
© 2026 TravelAdvisory。为世界各地的旅行者和开发者倾情打造。

payload.name: Iberia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Iberia GPT helps you plan your trip directly in ChatGPT. Search for Iberia flights, compare available options, explore destination ideas when you are not sure where to go, and use flexible dates to find the best deals for your plans. Once you choose your flight, you can continue the booking process securely through Iberia.
payload.longDescription: Iberia GPT 可直接在 ChatGPT 中帮助规划旅程。搜索 Iberia 航班、比较可选方案；如果还没确定目的地，也可以探索目的地灵感；还可以使用灵活日期，为行程寻找优惠。选好航班后，你可以通过 Iberia 安全地继续预订流程。

payload.name: ixigo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan smarter trips with flights, hotels, fare insights, and real-time travel updates - all within ChatGPT, powered by ixigo.

Search and compare one-way and round-trip flights across domestic and international routes with live fares, schedules, and flexible filtering. Discover hotels with your preferences - whether you're looking near a landmark, in a specific area, or with amenities like free breakfast,  jacuzzi, or couple-friendly stays.

Stay updated with live flight tracking and use fare intelligence to explore price trends across nearby dates, helping you find better deals. For last-mile travel, seamlessly continue to ixigo for cab bookings.

The experience adapts to your intent and prompts for missing details when needed, making travel planning faster, more intuitive, and personalized.
payload.longDescription:
借助 ixigo，在 ChatGPT 中规划更明智的行程，查询航班、酒店、票价信息和实时旅行动态。

搜索并比较国内及国际航线的单程和往返航班，查看实时票价和时刻表，并灵活筛选。根据偏好查找酒店，例如靠近地标、位于特定区域，或提供免费早餐、按摩浴缸、适合情侣入住等设施。

通过实时航班跟踪掌握最新动态，并利用票价分析了解临近日期的价格趋势，帮助你找到更优惠的选择。对于最后一程出行，可无缝前往 ixigo 预订出租车。

体验会根据你的意图进行调整，并在需要时询问缺失信息，让旅行规划更快捷、直观且个性化。

payload.name: FlixBus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan a trip with FlixBus directly in ChatGPT. Search routes between supported destinations across the globe, browse available bus and train options for your chosen date and proceed directly to checkout.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 FlixBus 规划行程。搜索全球支持目的地之间的路线，浏览所选日期可用的巴士和火车选项，然后直接前往结账。

payload.name: CheapOair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The CheapOair app allows users to search and compare airline flight options based on their origin, destination, travel dates, passenger details and cabin preference, and to search and compare hotel stays based on destination, check-in and check-out dates, guest occupancy and stay filters. The app does not collect payment or complete bookings within ChatGPT. When a user selects “Book on CheapOair,” they are redirected to Cheapoair.com, where fare or rate validation, traveller information, payment, ticketing, cancellations and refunds are handled.
payload.longDescription: CheapOair 应用允许用户根据出发地、目的地、旅行日期、乘客信息和舱位偏好搜索并比较航班，也可根据目的地、入住和退房日期、入住人数及住宿筛选条件搜索并比较酒店。应用不会在 ChatGPT 内收集付款或完成预订。用户选择“在 CheapOair 上预订”后会被重定向到 Cheapoair.com，由该网站处理票价或房价验证、旅客信息、付款、出票、取消和退款。

payload.name: Cruise Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cruise vacations filtered by destination, price, dates and preferred cruise line
payload.longDescription: 按目的地、价格、日期和偏好的邮轮公司筛选并搜索邮轮假期

payload.name: Hyatt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next Hyatt stay directly in ChatGPT. Search Hyatt hotels and resorts around the world and access information available on Hyatt.com—including real-time room availability, detailed room descriptions, and dynamic rate information—through simple, natural conversation. 
 
Ask for what you need in everyday language, browse tailored results with photos and amenities, and click through to Hyatt.com when you're ready to book. Log in or join World of Hyatt during booking to earn points, access exclusive member rates, and enjoy added benefits. 
 
Add the Hyatt app in ChatGPT and make planning your next trip effortless.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中规划下一次凯悦住宿。搜索全球 Hyatt 酒店和度假村，并通过简单自然的对话查询 Hyatt.com 上的信息，包括实时客房空房情况、详细房型说明和动态价格信息。

用日常语言说出需求，浏览带照片和设施信息的定制结果，准备预订时点击前往 Hyatt.com。预订时登录或加入 World of Hyatt，即可赚取积分、享受会员专属价格和其他福利。

在 ChatGPT 中添加 Hyatt 应用，让下一次旅行规划轻松起来。

payload.name: SIXT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SIXT enables users to search for and book rental cars directly from ChatGPT. The app helps users find available vehicles by location and date, compare car options, and review key rental details before booking. Once a suitable option is selected, users are directed to SIXT’s official website to complete their reservation. The app is designed to make the car rental booking process faster and more convenient by providing clear, relevant information at the moment users are planning their trips.
payload.longDescription: SIXT 让用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索并预订租车。该应用可按地点和日期查找可用车辆、比较车型，并在预订前查看重要租赁详情。选定合适的方案后，用户会跳转至 SIXT 官方网站完成预订。该应用旨在用户规划行程时提供清晰、相关的信息，让租车预订更快速方便。
